description: What to do in an emergency with no airplane picked: general good practice only, each item with its source -- fly the airplane and pick a field within reach (FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 18), ask for help early (AIM 6-1-2), squawk 7700 (AIM 6-2-2), MAYDAY on the frequency in use or 121.5 (AIM 6-3-1, 6-3-2), climb if possible (AIM 6-3-2), stay in VFR conditions and the pilot in command's authority to deviate (AIM 6-2-1, 6-1-1, 14 CFR 91.3(b)). No airplane's checklist, speeds, glide or distances.

source.description: Where it comes from: the AIM paragraph, the handbook's chapter or the CFR section.
